headline: Fish and Game commissioner to plead guilty in poaching case
pages: Idaho Fish and Game Commissioner Brody Harshbarger will plead guilty to two misdemeanors, hunting without a valid tag and shooting from or across a public highway, under a plea agreement filed last week. The state will dismiss five other misdemeanor charges. Under the agreement, his hunting privileges would be revoked for one year, and he would pay a $500 fine on each charge and serve six months of probation. Sentencing is set for Dec. 9 before a Fremont County judge. The governor's office said he had not resigned as of Monday. The Idaho Capital Sun also reported on the plea. The case matters because Harshbarger sits on the commission that oversees the state's wildlife rules.
